question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
-- Show all products with their percentage-point change, smallest absolute first
WITH qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cs1.cust_city
    FROM (
        SELECT c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id, SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
        FROM sales s
        JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
        JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
        JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
        WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
            AND s.promo_id = 999
            AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
        GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
    ) cs1
    JOIN (
        SELECT c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id, SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
        FROM sales s
        JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
        JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
        JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
        WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
            AND s.promo_id = 999
            AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
        GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
    ) cs2 ON cs1.cust_city = cs2.cust_city
    WHERE cs1.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
        AND cs2.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
        AND cs1.total_sales > 0
        AND 1.0 * cs2.total_sales / cs1.total_sales >= 1.20
),
product_city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        c.cust_city,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND s.promo_id = 999
        AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
        AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT prod_id, SUM(product_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_city_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
product_ranked AS (
    SELECT prod_id, total_sales,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as quintile
    FROM product_totals
),
top_20_percent AS (
    SELECT prod_id, total_sales
    FROM product_ranked
    WHERE quintile = 1
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(product_sales) as product_sales
    FROM product_city_sales
    WHERE prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_20_percent)
    GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_quarter_id
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT calendar_quarter_id, SUM(product_sales) as quarter_total
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        pqs.prod_id,
        pqs.calendar_quarter_id,
        pqs.product_sales,
        qt.quarter_total,
        ROUND(1.0 * pqs.product_sales / qt.quarter_total * 100, 4) as share_pct
    FROM product_quarter_sales pqs
    JOIN quarter_totals qt ON pqs.calendar_quarter_id = qt.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_share_pivot AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN share_pct END) as share_q4_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN share_pct END) as share_q4_2020
    FROM product_shares
    GROUP BY prod_id
)
SELECT 
    prod_id,
    share_q4_2019,
    share_q4_2020,
    ROUND(share_q4_2020 - share_q4_2019, 4) as pct_point_change,
    ROUND(ABS(share_q4_2020 - share_q4_2019), 4) as abs_change
FROM product_share_pivot
ORDER BY ABS(share_q4_2020 - share_q4_2019) ASC
